title: Terminal session
idea: Terminal session: Session identity and output keep command input grounded
audience: People who need to operate shell within a desktop surface.
worksWellWhen: A real authorized terminal is required
avoidWhen: The UI would fake command execution
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic command layout through its operate shell priority and explicit commitment contract: Show exit status and keep destructive command review explicit
navigation: Terminal session keeps the current operate shell context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Session identity and output keep command input grounded
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to operate shell; a real authorized terminal is required
composition.priority: Show exit status and keep destructive command review explicit

imagery.role: Support the actual operate shell context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Wrap or scroll output while preserving prompt context
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the terminal session structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no operate shell content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Show exit status and keep destructive command review explicit
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized operate shell content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Show exit status and keep destructive command review explicit
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active operate shell context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
